units.source_text: 末摘花痴心妄想地等候源氏公子，果然等着了，自然不胜欣喜。

en.t: Safflower had waited for Prince Genji with foolish longing, and when he really did come at last, she was naturally overjoyed.

units.source_text: 然而打扮得如此寒伧，怎么见得人来？

en.t: Yet dressed so shabbily, how could she possibly meet anyone?

units.source_text: 日前大弍夫人送她的衣服，她因为厌恶这个人，看也不曾看过，侍女们便拿去收藏在一只薰香的衣柜里。

en.t: The clothes that Lady Daini had sent her some days earlier had never even been looked at, because she disliked the woman, so the gentlewomen had taken them away and stored them in a perfumed wardrobe.

units.source_text: 她们现在把这衣服拿出来，香气非常馥郁，便劝小姐快穿。

en.t: Now they brought the clothes out, and since they were richly fragrant, they urged their lady to put them on at once.

units.source_text: 末摘花心里讨厌，然而无可奈何，只得换上了。

en.t: Safflower disliked it inwardly, but having no choice, she had to change into them.

units.source_text: 然后把那煤烟熏黑的帷屏移过来，坐在帷屏后面接待公子。

en.t: Then she had the soot-blackened curtain screen moved over and received the prince while sitting behind it.
